help.short: The name of the Maps Account.

description: Get the keys to use with the Maps APIs. A key is used to authenticate and authorize access to the Maps REST APIs. Only one key is needed at a time; two are given to provide seamless key regeneration.

operations.description: Get the keys to use with the Maps APIs. A key is used to authenticate and authorize access to the Maps REST APIs. Only one key is needed at a time; two are given to provide seamless key regeneration.

params.description: The name of the Maps Account.
params.name: accountName

params.description: The name of the resource group. The name is case insensitive.
params.name: resourceGroupName

params.description: The ID of the target subscription. The value must be an UUID.
params.name: subscriptionId

consts.description: The API version to use for this operation.
consts.name: api-version

props.description: The primary key for accessing the Maps REST APIs.
props.name: primaryKey

props.description: The last updated date and time of the primary key.
props.name: primaryKeyLastUpdated

props.description: The secondary key for accessing the Maps REST APIs.
props.name: secondaryKey

props.description: The last updated date and time of the secondary key.
props.name: secondaryKeyLastUpdated
